style_snapshot_scope: Comment-free digests of the unchanged base and Tier 3 inline style blocks in this repository template; shared report_ui.css.j2 presentation adaptations are listed separately and are not covered by these two baseline hashes.
intentional_adaptations: Public scores, gates, applicability, source identity and publication assessments remain authoritative.
Chart.js 4.5.1 and its existing MIT notices remain pinned.
Canonical retained exports are separate from bounded, sanitized display projections.
CLI JSON validator rows add a recorded boolean optional_skip, and the retained reader round-trips it; the retained Tier 3 object remains unchanged.
Clickable tier cards replace the previous left sidebar and sticky mobile tier bar.
Reports containing Tier 3 default to dark and other reports to light, replacing the device-theme default; saved Light, Dark and System choices take precedence.
Typed passive plugin evidence is routed into tier sections before rendering.
Overview summarizes recorded outcomes/actions; full Insights cards render once.
Concise failed-run summaries are a renderer-only projection; newly persisted failure conclusions and recommendations keep their existing raw error text.
Routine metadata, passive evidence and resource methods use closed disclosures.
Recorded token/latency adapters support native-shaped and current public evidence without collection or rescoring.
Accessible active-control contrast, wrapped mobile controls, keyboard navigation, search, deep links, no-JS and print behavior are retained.
Collection similarity counts use public validator identities.
Canonical public product branding is SkillEvaluator.
The full-size native header scrolls on narrow screens so it does not obscure report evidence.
Configured standard metrics remain explicitly unavailable in incomplete comparison tables; custom-only runs use their recorded metric names and values.
Harbor viewer fallback selects a usable sanitized primary or recorded summary without combining unrelated jobs or inferring URLs.
Renderer version sits beside the brand, with recorded SkillSpector versions in the Tier 1 tile; aligned screen content widens to 1280px while native typography and print sizing remain intact.
Recorded Harbor upload URLs survive shared display projection and directory regeneration, with live metadata taking precedence for the same job URL.
Overview combines recorded execution status, scored/unscored coverage and a next action; full diagnostics and authored Insights remain accessible in their owning views.
The native baseline comparison stays open with scores, baseline, lift, Overall and agent context visible; signal lists, definitions and detailed reasoning use closed adjacent disclosures.
A baseline aggregate missing after execution is labeled baseline quality unavailable; baseline not run requires a recorded skipped arm.
Native agent cards, renderer/scanner version placement and existing body, header and metric type scales are preserved; compact mobile changes adjust arrangement and spacing.

Dataset diagnostics group identical structured causes only within the same attempt and status, retaining all assertion IDs, requirement text, rubric checks and evidence associations within existing preview bounds.
Absent, null and empty pass-at-k case outcomes display N/A with retained attempt counts; explicit recorded zero outcomes remain zero without recomputing scores or denominators.
Concise Harbor labels use recorded agent and condition associations; exact job identifiers remain in Diagnostics and URLs are never inferred.

Optional recorded native plugin completeness, composition, delivery, refusal/comparison basis and recovery notes use bounded typed display adapters; only active warnings appear in Overview and routine detail stays closed in Agent Details, Trials or Diagnostics.
Native compatibility does not add backend execution, collection, scoring, gate policy or public producer coverage; hook census and canary runtime summaries remain a separate producer integration gap.
MCP failed-call and connected-unused interpretations require explicit recorded counts/status; missing measurements never become zero.
Scope-level catalog skip reasons and repeated passive evidence qualifications have one owner, while local row/note omissions and shortened text remain disclosed.
Embedded report JSON is compact and chart literals contain only consumed fields; canonical download reconstruction and escaping remain unchanged.

Charts initialize after theme selection when visible, reuse instances, and prepare all print charts synchronously; print reveals retained Dataset cases hidden by screen filters and restores screen disclosure/filter state.
Bounded native agent identities retain attribution after content-budget exhaustion; unused composition components retain their recorded kind and disclose omitted kind groups.
